re: running scripts is disabled on this system|cannot be loaded because running scripts is disabled|PSSecurityException|выполнение сценариев отключено
hint: Execution policy blocks .ps1 files. Run it as: run {command:"powershell", args:["-NoProfile","-ExecutionPolicy","Bypass","-File","C:\\path\\x.ps1"]}. Do not change the machine policy.

re: is not recognized as (the name of )?a cmdlet|is not recognized as an internal or external command|command not found|команда не найдена|No such file or directory.*(bash|sh):|CommandNotFoundException|не распознано как имя|не является внутренней или внешней
hint: The program is not installed or not on PATH. Check with util {op:"apps", name}, install with util {op:"install", name}, or call it by its full path. A program installed a moment ago is on PATH only for new processes: use the full path.

re: Access is denied|Access to the path .* is denied|UnauthorizedAccess|Permission denied|requires elevation|0x80070005|Отказано в доступе|PermissionDenied
hint: Needs administrator (root) rights. On Windows start the command elevated: start_process {command:"powershell", args:["-Command", "..."]} with Start-Process -Verb RunAs, and tell the friend to accept the UAC prompt. On Linux: sudo -n, or tell the friend to run it.

re: Unexpected token|Missing argument in parameter list|The string is missing the terminator|Missing closing|unexpected EOF while looking for matching|syntax error near unexpected token|A positional parameter cannot be found|is not valid JSON|Unexpected character encountered while parsing|ParserError|ParseException|MissingArgument|UnexpectedToken|TerminatorExpectedAtEndOfString
hint: Quoting broke. For an exe with tricky arguments use run {command:"exe", args:[...]} (no shell, each argument arrives exactly as given). For longer scripts write the script with write_file and run the file. For file edits use edit_file instead of shell text tools.

re: being used by another process|The process cannot access the file|Text file busy|Device or resource busy|занят другим процессом|используется другим процессом
hint: The file is locked by a running program. Find it with system {sections:["processes"]} and close it (util {op:"kill", name}) only if the friend agrees, then retry.

re: There is not enough space on the disk|No space left on device|0x80070070|Недостаточно места на диске
hint: The disk is full. See system {sections:["disks"]}, then tree with sizes on the user folders to find what is big; ask before deleting anything.

re: No package found matching input criteria|No installed package found matching
hint: winget does not know that name. Search first: run {command:"winget", args:["search","<name>","--accept-source-agreements"]}, then util {op:"install", name:"<exact Id>"}.

re: 'winget' is not recognized|winget: command not found
hint: winget is missing (old Windows 10 or LTSC). Download the installer with util {op:"download"} and start it, or ask the friend to update App Installer from the Microsoft Store.

re: Could not create SSL/TLS secure channel|certificate verify failed|CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED|The underlying connection was closed
hint: TLS problem: on Windows PowerShell 5.1 prefix [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol=3072; check the system clock (system overview) and whether a proxy / antivirus intercepts HTTPS.

re: No such host is known|Name or service not known|Temporary failure in name resolution|Unable to connect to the remote server|Connection refused|connect(ion)? timed out|Этот хост неизвестен|Не удается разрешить удаленное имя|Невозможно соединиться с удаленным сервером
hint: Network problem. util {op:"net_test", host, port} shows whether DNS and the port work; util {op:"dns_flush"} helps after a DNS change.
The command did not finish in time. Raise timeout_s, or start long jobs with start_process and check their output later.

re: old text not found|old text found \d+ times
hint: Read the exact lines first with read_file {path, offset, lines} and copy them into old (spaces and line breaks included).
